Title: Svelte tutorial — Lily Design System

Description: Build accessible, styled form with Lily Svelte 5 headless components: runes, snippets, and bind:value.

# Svelte tutorial

Lily Svelte library na di canonical implementation: Svelte 5 runes, typed props, rest-prop spread, and two-way binding with `bind:value`.

## Wetin you go build

Small contact form — input wey get label, submit button, two-way binding, real keyboard and screen-reader behaviour — first bare, then styled, for about 10 minutes.

## Before you start

You need git, Node 22 or newer, and pnpm 10 or newer. Any Svelte 5 project dey work — fresh `npx sv create` app go do.

## Step 1 — Get di code

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-headless
pnpm install
pnpm test        # vitest — thousands of component cases
pnpm run storybook   # browse all 608 components
```

Di components dey live inside `src/lib/components/&#123;Name&#125;/`, one directory for each component wey get di `.svelte` file, im tests, im stories, and im docs side by side. Copy di directories wey you need enter your app, or depend on di repo and import directly.

## Step 2 — Your first component

```
<script>
  import Button from "#lib/components/Button/Button.svelte";

  function save() { console.log("saved"); }
</script>

<Button onclick={save}>Save</Button>
```

E dey render `<button class="button" type="button">`. Di props dey typed: `type`, `disabled`, `pressed` (e dey render `aria-pressed` for toggle buttons), `label` (an `aria-label` override), and any extra attribute go spread onto di root.

## Step 3 — Compose small form

```
<script>
  import Form from "#lib/components/Form/Form.svelte";
  import Field from "#lib/components/Field/Field.svelte";
  import TextInput from "#lib/components/TextInput/TextInput.svelte";
  import Button from "#lib/components/Button/Button.svelte";

  let name = $state("");
</script>

<Form label="Contact form" onsubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <Field label="Full name" required>
    <TextInput id="name" label="Full name" bind:value={name} required />
  </Field>
  <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
</Form>
```

`Field` dey take di visible `label` as im own prop instead of nested label component — pass am once, on `Field`, and `TextInput`for `label` dey provide di accessible name. `TextInput`'s `value` na `$bindable` rune prop, so `bind:value` dey give you two-way binding straight away.

**Verified 2026-08-29:** dis exact snippet dem compile through `svelte/server` and check am for single, correctly linked `<label for>` — earlier draft nest separate `Label` inside `Field`, wey render *two* labels (one empty) because `Field` already dey render im own from di `label` prop. Di [contact-form composed route](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples/src/routes/contact-form/%2Bpage.svelte) na di same pattern, wey real e2e and axe tests don exercise.

**Check your work:** run di app and di form go look plain — exactly as dem plan am: di styling still dey come. Press `Tab`: focus go move through every control, di label go dey announced, and submit dey work. Di behaviour don finish; di look na yours and e be next.

## Step 4 — Style am

Everything above dey render as pure structure, ready for your styles. Style di class hooks — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — inside your global stylesheet, or link ready-made theme inside `app.html`:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/dark.css" />
```

Per-instance tweaks dey go through di `class` prop, wey dem append to di base hook: `<Button class="wide">` dey render `class="button wide"`.

## Step 5 — See everything dey work

Di [SvelteKit example app](https://lilydesignsystem.com/pcm-001/examples/) na di same catalog fully styled, with live demos, Playwright e2e tests, and axe-core accessibility baseline:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-sveltekit-examples
pnpm install && pnpm run dev
```
